description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes Deployment resources in the extensions/v1beta1 API group, including methods for create, update, delete, get, list, watch, patch, apply, and scale operations.

classes.name: deployments
classes.description: Implementation of DeploymentInterface for managing Deployment resources within a specific namespace.

methods.name: newDeployments
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new deployments client for a given namespace.

methods.name: GetScale
methods.description: Retrieves the scale subresource for a specific deployment.

methods.name: UpdateScale
methods.description: Updates the scale subresource for a specific deployment.

methods.name: ApplyScale
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the scale subresource of a deployment.
